episodes.title: The Violent Radical Left Cult the Media Won’t Cover – with Andy Ngo
episodes.description:
Freddy Gray sits down with investigative journalist Andy Ngo to unpack his reporting on the controversial marriage allegations surrounding Congresswoman Ilhan Omar before delving deep into his new true-crime book 'The Zizians: Inside a Trans Death Cult', examining the Zizians, an insular, Silicon Valley-born cult that Ngo argues mainstream media has actively ignored.
